{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fitted thermal leggings, ankle length, color #2b2b30, merino-blend knit, worn under the trousers
Fine-gauge turtleneck sweater, regular fit, hip length, color #e9e2d6 (warm ivory), merino wool
Straight-leg trousers, full length reaching the top of the boot, color #4a4e57 (charcoal grey), heavy wool-blend twill
Knee-length hooded coat, slightly A-line, color #1f2a44 (deep navy), down-filled with a wool-blend outer shell and a water-repellent finish
Ankle boots, low block heel, waterproof leather, color #1c1c1e, with a deep-tread rubber sole for snow and salt
Thick socks, mid-calf, color #5a5d66, merino wool
Scarf, wide and long enough to wrap twice, color #b9c4d6 (pale blue-grey), soft wool
Gloves, wrist length, color #1c1c1e, leather lined with cashmere
Beanie, close fit, color #4a4e57, ribbed wool
Structured tote, fits a laptop or documents, color #1c1c1e, water-resistant coated leather

This outfit keeps the neat business look, a refined knit with tailored trousers and ankle boots, while the insulated knee-length coat and layered knitwear handle a 20-minute walk in deep frost and snow. The boots have a grippy sole and waterproof leather, so slush and road salt are easy to wipe off, and the full-length trousers meet the boot tops to keep ankles covered. The warm ivory knit sits close to your face and brightens your fair skin, while the pale blue-grey scarf echoes your eye color against the deep navy coat and dark hair. Once you take off the coat and hat at the office, the sweater and trousers look polished and professional."}
